responsibility_observations.behavior: QUrl overload rejects non-local URLs; QStringList overload rejects directories, nonexistent/nonregular/unreadable/empty files, and non-Premium/Premium size excess. Without errorCallback it returns the first error result; with callback it reports and skips the offending item, preserving valid items. TooLarge carries the observed size.
responsibility_observations.boundary: The observed upstream limits are 2000MiB and 4000MiB from localimageloader.h:35-39, not Fabushi's service25MiB. These functions do not establish chat membership or upload credentials.

responsibility_observations.behavior: Distinguishes image clipboard, local files, folders, photo/media sets and archive candidates; refuses internal x-td-forward MIME and non-local URL lists. responsibility_observations.boundary: Header includes classification variants not emitted by ComputeMimeDataState itself; caller refinements cannot be discarded. Filename/MIME probing is a hint, not permission.

responsibility_observations.behavior: Builds editor audio tracks with positive duration and optional validated cover; media reader chooses audio by MIME/name, otherwise FileLoadTask media detection. Video retains raw thumbnail, path/content, duration and only marks audio when FFmpeg finds a decodable audio stream. In-memory media and file-backed video use an image-read byte budget.

responsibility_observations.behavior: Nonanimated valid-dimension images become photos, valid video thumbnails become video, songs become music; silent video defaults to GIF mode. Previews apply geometry, maintain dimensions/device pixel ratio, and blur whichever video image has fewer pixels. Invalid scaled image records diagnostic dimensions and fails an invariant.

responsibility_observations.behavior: Archives and video/animation each have a serial preparation queue, so one of each category may run concurrently. Archive size/error outcomes have dedicated UI feedback. Success updates document bytes/path/size, progress and part sizing before upload.

responsibility_observations.behavior: Reads one docPartSize from in-memory content at an offset or lazily opened QFile. responsibility_observations.behavior: Document part sizes step through32/64/128/256/512KiB; a4000-part threshold influences selection, but the last512KiB selection is not rejected when its return is false. Completion forwards input-file metadata, thumbnails/stickers/options/forceFile.
responsibility_observations.boundary: These are transport-specific representations. MD5 is a wire checksum here, not an authorization/integrity replacement for Fabushi's account/request scoped snapshot SHA256.

responsibility_observations.behavior: Tracks outstanding bytes by upload DC session, fills up to about1MiB per session, grows to at most8 after all existing sessions have sufficiently fast requests, and removes a session after slow responses subject to an8s normalization interval. Removed-session requests retain bytes for resubmission. Pacing uses250ms despite an older half-second comment.
responsibility_observations.boundary: Selection skips preparing entries; ready notification remains queue-front ordered. In-flight requests, timers and maps are memory-owned here. MTP callback-thread and retry defaults are delegated.
responsibility_observations.mapping: Current Native single multipart POST is bounded but provides no equivalent part-level resumable upload scheduler or user-visible pause/progress contract in the inspected path.

responsibility_observations.behavior: pause stores an item ID but maybeSend treats any paused ID as a global stop for new dispatch; existing requests continue. cancel calls the same failed path as transport errors, sets preparation cancellation, removes the entry, emits type-specific failure, cancels its part requests and schedules other work. cancelAll drains the queue then clears and unpauses. Ordinary RPC failure fails the whole file; removed-DC replay is a distinct in-memory recovery path.
responsibility_observations.boundary: No on-disk uploader checkpoint is written in these four files. Application-level restart/resume cannot be inferred absent or implemented without its external callers and storage.
